notes.title: Update 0.2.3
notes.content:
[u]Patch Notes:[/u]

- Added 5 new Upgrade Trees (20 new Upgrades)
- Player now also takes damage when colliding with enemy, regardless of enemy attack animation state (rare cases where player is running way too fast so enemies don't have time to play their attack animation)
- Fixed a bug where clicking quickly multiple times on select upgrade button would apply the upgrade as many times

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.2.2
notes.content:
[u]Patch notes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Refined move speeds, knockback and velocity curves to give the player more control an make enemies more forgiving (for instance enemies now take a little bit longer to change directions).
[*] Boss now has a zone visual feedback when he charges
[*] Tweaked Boss behaviour and reduced fire circle radius
[*] Suicide Bombers now have a different color (making them easier to spot among the crowd)
[*] Increased size and speed of Holy Flail
[*] Changed behaviour of bullets generated by the "Splinter" upgrade.
[*] After unlocking a tier 2 upgrade in a tree, the next proposed upgrade can be either the tier 3 or the other tier 2 (was always tier 3 first before patch)
[*] Added a sound when enemies are hit
[*] Changed various upgrade stats to refine balancing
[*] Added a short cooldown to player taking damage (two enemies can't hit at the same time anymore)
[/list]

notes.title: Open playtest is live!
notes.content:
Greetings folks!

The first Hell Survivors open playtest has just been released!

You can access the playtest for free via the Hell Survivors Steam page.

[u]What content is in the playtest:[/u]
[list]
[*] Run time of 5 minutes
[*] 1 Hero
[*] 1 Weapon
[*] 5 Upgrade Trees (20 upgrades total)
[*] 1 Map
[*] 4 Enemies including 1 Elite and 1 Boss
[/list]
Please keep in mind this is not representative of the final game's content. This content will expand during development.

[u]Why this playtest?[/u]
As a solo developer, getting feedback from the community is crucial!
This playtest allows players to get their hands on a first playable build of Hell Survivors, and give general feedback, report bugs, balancing issues, and everything that may come to mind.

[u]How to give feedback?[/u]
You can give feedback via the Steam forums, but the preferred way is via our Discord: https://discord.gg/pVngAWRv3c


[u]How long the playtest will be available?[/u]
The playtest will end on june 6.

Can't wait to get your feedback!

Cheers,
Max
